identity.name: Pelican Preserve
identity.hoa_name: Pelican Preserve Master Association (with separate sub-associations per neighborhood/building)
identity.notes: A 55+ gated community in Cape Coral, Florida, with multiple housing types (carriage homes, cottage duplexes, single-family Grand Cottage/Estate homes, and condos). Features a Town Center (Plaza del Sol), 38-acre nature preserve, extensive recreational amenities, and multiple sub-associations. Post-Hurricane Ian insurance has significantly increased carrying costs.

fees.note: Overall HOA fee range $550–$750/month depending on unit type (the figure quoted in listings/brochures). Breakdown by unit type: Carriage Homes ~$580–$680/mo (master + sub-assoc: exterior maintenance, landscaping); Cottage Duplexes ~$600–$700/mo (master + sub-assoc: landscaping, amenity access); Single-Family Grand Cottage/Estate ~$620–$750/mo (master only — owner maintains own exterior and carries own insurance). Master association covers Town Center, gated access, community amenities, management. Condo/carriage home sub-association fees include master policy covering building exterior and roof; personal HO-6 covers contents/interior. True monthly carrying cost (HOA + CDD + taxes + post-Ian insurance) runs $1,700–$2,700+ before mortgage. Post-Ian Lee County homeowners insurance is the most expensive line item for single-family owners. CDD assessment appears on tax bill, not HOA statement. Golf club is a separate membership. Lee County property taxes and senior exemptions mentioned but no specific figures given. Fees change with annual budgeting — request current budget/estoppel to confirm.

Master HOA fee historically $150–$200/month (base layer every owner pays regardless of housing type; funds gates/security, common areas, Town Center Plaza del Sol, 38-acre nature preserve and boardwalk trail, community roads, shared landscaping). Condo sub-association fee runs $250–$450/month on top of master (covers building exterior, roof, elevators, pest control, often cable/internet).
CDD assessment exists and appears on property tax bill (not HOA statement). CDD financed construction of community infrastructure. Specific dollar amount not stated in available content.

Estimated HOA range by unit type (master + sub-association combined): condos (Napoli etc.) ~$550-650/mo; carriage homes ~$580-680/mo; cottage duplexes ~$600-700/mo; single-family Grand Cottage/Estate ~$620-750/mo (master assoc. only). Third-party guide estimates, not official HOA figures. Master fee covers Town Center, gated access, community amenities, management; sub-assoc fees cover exterior maintenance, landscaping, building insurance on attached units. $600 shown as midpoint of overall $550-750 range quoted in listings/brochures/55places.com per this source. Post-Ian true carrying cost cited as $1,700-2,700+/mo before mortgage incl. CDD, taxes, insurance. Retrieved 2026-02-10T12:00:00Z (UTC). Confidence 0.55 (reputable third-party guide, not official).

CDD annual debt service (municipal bonds financing Town Center and infrastructure) appears as non-ad valorem assessment on Lee County tax bill. Typical range $1,800-$3,200/yr ($150-$267/mo), varies by phase and lot; older sections may be nearly paid off. $2,500 shown as midpoint. Verify exact line via leepa.org parcel lookup / last two years of tax bills. Retrieved 2026-02-10T12:00:00Z (UTC). Confidence 0.55 (third-party guide estimate).

Post-Hurricane Ian insurance estimates: single-family wind/homeowners insurance $4,000-$9,000/yr; flood insurance (if required/chosen) $1,500-$4,000/yr; combined $6,000-$13,000/yr for typical single-family home. Condos/carriage homes with HOA master policy: HO-6 interior policy typically $800-$2,000/yr. Premiums 50-150% higher than 2021 rates per source. $6,500 shown as midpoint of combined single-family range. Estimates, not quotes. Retrieved 2026-02-10T12:00:00Z (UTC). Confidence 0.5 (third-party guide estimate).

OPTIONAL Pelican Preserve Golf Club membership (separate from HOA): source states membership typically $3,000-$6,000/yr by level (social, intermediate, full golf) plus cart fees and dining minimums; non-member green fees $50-$100+/round. $4,500 shown as midpoint. Conflicts with amenities page figure (see separate fact). Retrieved 2026-02-10T12:00:00Z (UTC). Confidence 0.5 (third-party guide estimate).

OPTIONAL golf club membership per amenities page: social memberships $1,500-$2,500/yr (clubhouse dining/social, no course access); full golf memberships $4,000-$6,000/yr (unlimited or limited rounds by tier); cart fees additional. $5,000 shown as midpoint of full-golf range. Conflicts with costs page range ($3,000-$6,000); both reported. Retrieved 2026-02-10T12:00:00Z (UTC). Confidence 0.5 (third-party guide estimate).

55places.com lists HOA dues as $65-$678/mo (aggregated third-party data, unverified by HOA). $678 shown as upper bound. Retrieved 2026-02-10T12:00:00Z (UTC). Confidence 0.5 (listing aggregator, self-declared unverified).
